articles.title: NASA's Moon Rocket Gets a Giant Lego Piece!
articles.summary: A huge rocket booster part just rolled into NASA's giant building in Florida. It's one of two that will give the Artemis III rocket over 75% of its liftoff power—enough to lift 14 jumbo jets!

articles.title: Fuzzy Tummy Bugs Make Cows Burp Methane!
articles.summary: Scientists found a tiny new part inside microbes in cow stomachs that makes hydrogen gas. That gas feeds other microbes that produce methane—a powerful greenhouse gas. One cow can burp out 220 pounds of methane a year!

articles.title: Spider Dads: The Surprising Story of Fatherhood in Creepy-Crawlies
articles.summary: Citizen scientists helped discover that daddy longlegs relatives have evolved fatherly care many times. Using iNaturalist, researchers doubled the known cases of egg-guarding dads, finding the behavior appeared, vanished, and reappeared over millions of years.
